Ahmed was tasked with enhancing lead management in the CRM and setting up 20-30 minute introductory calls, particularly addressing the situation with a potential public company, Hopscotch Group, while investigating why some software companies were rejecting TSG. Action items were assigned, including Ahmed's preparations for the next call and Jack's follow-up on the Imaginary Content offer and evaluations of TSG pricing.
